app.name: Film Society

lobby.title: The Lobby
lobby.subtitle: Tonight's programme, chosen for you

people.title: People
people.noSuggestions: Once you are in a group, the people in it show up here so you do not have to look them up.

edit.title: Edit profile
edit.avatarHint: JPEG, PNG or WebP, up to 2 MB.
edit.bioPlaceholder: A line or two. Shown on your profile.
edit.countryHint: Sets which age ratings and streaming services you see.
edit.useNotes: Use my notes to improve recommendations
edit.useNotesHint: Your notes say far more about a film than a score does, so the lobby can read them when choosing what to show you. Turning this on sends the text of your notes to the AI that builds your wall. Other people never see them either way.

me.title: Me

swipe.needTitles: Add some titles to this list first.

swipe.noMatches: Nothing on this list matches those filters.

auth.tagline: Members only. Both doors are through here.
auth.usernameHint: Letters, numbers and underscores. This is how others see you.

chooser.subtitle: Which way tonight?

chooser.bookNote: What you have read, what you are in the middle of, and what to read next.
chooser.switchHint: You can walk through to the other side whenever you like. This only asks once.

shelf.endOfShelf: That is the shelf for now
shelf.noneCame: Nothing came back this time. The shop may just need asking again.

progress.tellGroups: Tell my groups I am reading this

log.reading: You are in the middle of

log.startedHint: Leave it blank if you would rather not say.
